fine_lines.title: wear vs try on
fine_lines.explanation_ar: wear = يرتدي الملابس عادةً، و try on = يجرّب الملابس في المتجر ليرى هل تناسبه.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "wear" = have clothes on. "try on" = put clothes on in a shop to check them.

examples.sentence: Can I try on this dress?

expressions.phrase: Please can I have some money?
expressions.meaning_ar: من فضلك، هل يمكنني الحصول على بعض المال؟
expressions.example: Mum, please can I have some money for a book?
We are at the shop. What do you want?

expressions.meaning_en: Said to make someone feel better.
expressions.example: Don't worry. We will find something.

expressions.phrase: A smile is all you need.
expressions.meaning_en: A smile is more important than new clothes.
expressions.example: You don't need new clothes. A smile is all you need.

grammar.title: Past simple: was / were and -ed verbs
grammar.explanation_ar: القصة في الماضي. نستخدم was مع I/he/she/it و were مع you/we/they. والأفعال المنتظمة نضيف لها ed: look → looked.
grammar.explanation_en: The story is in the past. Use was (I/he/she/it) and were (you/we/they). Regular verbs add -ed: look → looked.

questions.question: Amy went to the mall with her ___.
questions.explanation_ar: ذهبت إيمي إلى المركز مع جدتها.
questions.explanation_en: Amy went shopping with her gran.

questions.question: In the end, what did Amy wear?
choices: her old jeans and blue T-shirt
questions.explanation_en: She wore her old jeans and the blue T-shirt.

questions.question: What is "the perfect thing"?
questions.explanation_en: The perfect thing is a smile.

questions.question: You put on clothes in a shop to check them. You ___ them.
questions.explanation_en: try on = put on to check.

questions.question: Amy was very ___. She needed a rest.
Amy ___ very excited. (past)
questions.explanation_ar: مع she في الماضي نستخدم was.
questions.explanation_en: With she in the past, use was.

questions.question: They ___ in the shop. (past)
questions.explanation_ar: مع they في الماضي نستخدم were.
questions.explanation_en: With they in the past, use were.

questions.question: Choose the correct past sentence.
questions.explanation_en: The past of smile is smiled.
